main.description: Full-text search over the records in the permissioned spaces the caller can read, most relevant first. Without a space, searches every space the caller can read. Callable with OAuth, service auth, or a space credential; a space credential can only search its own space.

q.description: The text to search for. Free-form; not a query syntax.

space.description: Only search this space. A space credential only searches its own space, so it is implied there.

collection.description: Only return records in these collections.

repo.description: Only return records from this account's repo.

limit.description: The maximum number of records to return. A page can hold fewer, even when more follow.

snippet.description: A fragment of the record's text with the matches wrapped in <mark></mark>. The rest is unescaped record text, so escape it before rendering as HTML.
